meta.source: 大學入學考試中心 歷年學科能力測驗 英文科 第壹部分 詞彙題(第 1–10 題)
meta.note: 題目與答案取自大考中心公布之試題與選擇題答案;112 學年度各題與 111 第 4 題的空格位置為依句意補回。中文釋義為自編。

questions.q: John's clock is not functioning ______. The alarm rings even when it's not set to go off.
questions.full: John's clock is not functioning properly. The alarm rings even when it's not set to go off.

questions.q: Michael has decided to ______ a career in physics and has set his mind on becoming a professor.
questions.full: Michael has decided to pursue a career in physics and has set his mind on becoming a professor.

questions.q: Peter plans to hike in a ______ part of Africa, where he might not meet another human being for days.
questions.full: Peter plans to hike in a remote part of Africa, where he might not meet another human being for days.

questions.q: People in this community tend to ______ with the group they belong to, and often put group interests before personal ones.
questions.full: People in this community tend to identify with the group they belong to, and often put group interests before personal ones.

questions.q: I mistook the man for a well-known actor and asked for his autograph; it was really ______.
questions.full: I mistook the man for a well-known actor and asked for his autograph; it was really embarrassing.

questions.q: After spending most of her salary on rent and food, Amelia ______ had any money left for entertainment and other expenses.
questions.full: After spending most of her salary on rent and food, Amelia barely had any money left for entertainment and other expenses.

questions.q: In the Bermuda Triangle, a region in the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean, some airplanes and ships were reported to have mysteriously disappeared without a ______.
questions.full: In the Bermuda Triangle, a region in the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean, some airplanes and ships were reported to have mysteriously disappeared without a trace.

questions.q: Shouting greetings and waving a big sign, Tony ______ the passing shoppers to visit his shop and buy the freshly baked bread.
questions.full: Shouting greetings and waving a big sign, Tony urged the passing shoppers to visit his shop and buy the freshly baked bread.

questions.q: With a continuous 3 km stretch of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing ______ with its fine soft sand.
questions.full: With a continuous 3 km stretch of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing sculptures with its fine soft sand.

questions.q: The clouds parted and a ______ of light fell on the church, through the windows, and onto the floor.
questions.full: The clouds parted and a beam of light fell on the church, through the windows, and onto the floor.

questions.q: Mangoes are a ______ fruit here in Taiwan; most of them reach their peak of sweetness in July.
questions.full: Mangoes are a seasonal fruit here in Taiwan; most of them reach their peak of sweetness in July.

questions.q: Writing term papers and giving oral reports are typical course ______ for college students.
questions.full: Writing term papers and giving oral reports are typical course requirements for college students.

questions.q: If we work hard to ______ our dreams when we are young, we will not feel that we missed out on something when we get old.
questions.full: If we work hard to fulfill our dreams when we are young, we will not feel that we missed out on something when we get old.

questions.q: Few people will trust you if you continue making ______ promises and never make efforts to keep them.
questions.full: Few people will trust you if you continue making hollow promises and never make efforts to keep them.

questions.q: Becky ______ her ankle while she was playing tennis last week. Now it still hurts badly.
questions.full: Becky twisted her ankle while she was playing tennis last week. Now it still hurts badly.

questions.q: Research shows that men and women usually think differently. For example, they have quite different ______ about what marriage means in their life.
questions.full: Research shows that men and women usually think differently. For example, they have quite different beliefs about what marriage means in their life.

questions.q: The new manager is very ______. For instance, the employees are given much shorter deadlines for the same tasks than before.
questions.full: The new manager is very demanding. For instance, the employees are given much shorter deadlines for the same tasks than before.

questions.q: While the couple were looking ______ for their missing children, the kids were actually having fun in the woods nearby.
questions.full: While the couple were looking anxiously for their missing children, the kids were actually having fun in the woods nearby.

questions.q: After delivering a very powerful speech, the award winner was ______ by a group of fans asking for her signature.
questions.full: After delivering a very powerful speech, the award winner was surrounded by a group of fans asking for her signature.

questions.q: The interviewees were trying very hard to ______ the interviewers that they were very capable and should be given the job.
questions.full: The interviewees were trying very hard to impress the interviewers that they were very capable and should be given the job.

questions.q: Bobby cared a lot about his ______ at home and asked his parents not to go through his things without his permission.
questions.full: Bobby cared a lot about his privacy at home and asked his parents not to go through his things without his permission.

questions.q: The new manager is a real gentleman. He is kind and humble, totally different from the former manager, who was ______ and bossy.
questions.full: The new manager is a real gentleman. He is kind and humble, totally different from the former manager, who was mean and bossy.

questions.q: The weather bureau ______ that the typhoon would bring strong winds and heavy rains, and warned everyone of the possible danger.
questions.full: The weather bureau predicted that the typhoon would bring strong winds and heavy rains, and warned everyone of the possible danger.

questions.q: Different airlines have different ______ for carry-on luggage, but many international airlines limit a carry-on piece to 7 kilograms.
questions.full: Different airlines have different restrictions for carry-on luggage, but many international airlines limit a carry-on piece to 7 kilograms.

questions.q: Many people were happy that the government had finally ______ Children's Day as a national holiday.
questions.full: Many people were happy that the government had finally declared Children's Day as a national holiday.

questions.q: To reach the goal of making her company a market leader, Michelle ______ a plan to open ten new stores around the country this year.
questions.full: To reach the goal of making her company a market leader, Michelle proposed a plan to open ten new stores around the country this year.

questions.q: Silence in some way is as ______ as speech. It can be used to show, for example, disagreement or lack of interest.
questions.full: Silence in some way is as expressive as speech. It can be used to show, for example, disagreement or lack of interest.

questions.q: This TV program is designed for children, ______ for those under five. It contains no violence or strong language.
questions.full: This TV program is designed for children, particularly for those under five. It contains no violence or strong language.

questions.q: Tommy, please put away the toys in the box, or you might ______ on them and hurt yourself.
questions.full: Tommy, please put away the toys in the box, or you might stumble on them and hurt yourself.

questions.q: The ______ costume party, held every September, is one of the biggest events of the school year.
questions.full: The annual costume party, held every September, is one of the biggest events of the school year.

questions.q: After hours of discussion, our class finally reached the ______ that we would go to Hualien for our graduation trip.
questions.full: After hours of discussion, our class finally reached the conclusion that we would go to Hualien for our graduation trip.

questions.q: Jane ______ her teacher by passing the exam with a nearly perfect score; she almost failed the course last semester.
questions.full: Jane amazed her teacher by passing the exam with a nearly perfect score; she almost failed the course last semester.

questions.q: The vacuum cleaner is not working. Let's send it back to the ______ to have it inspected and repaired.
questions.full: The vacuum cleaner is not working. Let's send it back to the manufacturer to have it inspected and repaired.

questions.q: Due to the global financial crisis, the country's exports ______ by 40 percent last month, the largest drop since 2000.
questions.full: Due to the global financial crisis, the country's exports decreased by 40 percent last month, the largest drop since 2000.

questions.q: The potato chips have been left uncovered on the table for such a long time that they no longer taste fresh and ______.
questions.full: The potato chips have been left uncovered on the table for such a long time that they no longer taste fresh and crispy.

questions.q: The townspeople built a ______ in memory of the brave teacher who sacrificed her life to save her students from a burning bus.
questions.full: The townspeople built a monument in memory of the brave teacher who sacrificed her life to save her students from a burning bus.

questions.q: The students in Professor Smith's classical Chinese class are required to ______ poems by famous Chinese poets.
questions.full: The students in Professor Smith's classical Chinese class are required to recite poems by famous Chinese poets.

questions.q: Although Mr. Tang claims that the house belongs to him, he has not offered any proof of ______.
questions.full: Although Mr. Tang claims that the house belongs to him, he has not offered any proof of ownership.

questions.q: Ancient Athens, famous for its early development of the democratic system, is often said to be the ______ of democracy.
questions.full: Ancient Athens, famous for its early development of the democratic system, is often said to be the cradle of democracy.

questions.q: The candy can no longer be sold because it was found to contain artificial ingredients far beyond the ______ level.
questions.full: The candy can no longer be sold because it was found to contain artificial ingredients far beyond the permissible level.

questions.q: Tom is really a naughty boy. He likes to ______ and play jokes on his younger sister when their parents are not around.
questions.full: Tom is really a naughty boy. He likes to tease and play jokes on his younger sister when their parents are not around.

questions.q: Elderly shoppers in this store are advised to take the elevator rather than the ______, which may move too fast for them to keep their balance.
questions.full: Elderly shoppers in this store are advised to take the elevator rather than the escalator, which may move too fast for them to keep their balance.

questions.q: Upon hearing its master's call, the dog wagged its tail, and followed her out of the room ______.
questions.full: Upon hearing its master's call, the dog wagged its tail, and followed her out of the room obediently.

questions.q: Since many of our house plants are from humid jungle environments, they need ______ air to keep them green and healthy.
questions.full: Since many of our house plants are from humid jungle environments, they need moist air to keep them green and healthy.

questions.q: The skydiver managed to land safely after jumping out of the aircraft, even though her ______ failed to open in midair.
questions.full: The skydiver managed to land safely after jumping out of the aircraft, even though her parachute failed to open in midair.

questions.q: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to power heavy machines, brought about a ______ change in society.
questions.full: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to power heavy machines, brought about a revolutionary change in society.

questions.q: To encourage classroom ______, the teacher divided the class into groups and asked them to solve a problem together with their partners.
questions.full: To encourage classroom interaction, the teacher divided the class into groups and asked them to solve a problem together with their partners.

questions.q: Lisa ______ onto the ground and injured her ankle while she was playing basketball yesterday.
questions.full: Lisa tumbled onto the ground and injured her ankle while she was playing basketball yesterday.

questions.q: Hundreds of residents received free testing ______ from the city government to find out if their water contained any harmful chemicals.
questions.full: Hundreds of residents received free testing kits from the city government to find out if their water contained any harmful chemicals.

questions.q: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded ______ to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women's rights.
questions.full: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded jointly to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women's rights.

questions.q: When Jeffery doesn't feel like cooking, he often orders pizza online and has it ______ to his house.
questions.full: When Jeffery doesn't feel like cooking, he often orders pizza online and has it delivered to his house.

questions.q: Jane is the best ______ I have ever had. I cannot imagine running my office without her help.
questions.full: Jane is the best assistant I have ever had. I cannot imagine running my office without her help.

questions.q: The temple celebrated Mazu Festival by hosting ten days of lion dances, Taiwanese operas, and traditional hand ______ shows.
questions.full: The temple celebrated Mazu Festival by hosting ten days of lion dances, Taiwanese operas, and traditional hand puppet shows.

questions.q: The new vaccine was banned by the Food and Drug Administration due to its ______ fatal side effects.
questions.full: The new vaccine was banned by the Food and Drug Administration due to its potentially fatal side effects.

questions.q: ______ the photos with dates and keywords help you sort them easily in your file.
questions.full: Tagging the photos with dates and keywords help you sort them easily in your file.

questions.q: An ______ person is usually pleasant and easy to get along with, but don't expect that he or she will always say "yes" to everything.
questions.full: An agreeable person is usually pleasant and easy to get along with, but don't expect that he or she will always say "yes" to everything.

questions.q: Hidden deep in a small alley among various tiny shops, the entrance of the Michelin star restaurant is barely ______ to passersby.
questions.full: Hidden deep in a small alley among various tiny shops, the entrance of the Michelin star restaurant is barely visible to passersby.

questions.q: The original budget for my round-island trip was NT$5,000, but the ______ cost is likely to be 50 percent higher.
questions.full: The original budget for my round-island trip was NT$5,000, but the eventual cost is likely to be 50 percent higher.

questions.q: After watching a TV program on natural history, Adam decided to go on a ______ for dinosaur fossils in South Dakota.
questions.full: After watching a TV program on natural history, Adam decided to go on a quest for dinosaur fossils in South Dakota.

questions.q: With pink cherry blossoms blooming everywhere, the valley ______ like a young bride under the bright spring sunshine.
questions.full: With pink cherry blossoms blooming everywhere, the valley blushes like a young bride under the bright spring sunshine.

questions.q: The bus driver often complains about chewing gum found under passenger seats because it is ______ and very hard to remove.
questions.full: The bus driver often complains about chewing gum found under passenger seats because it is sticky and very hard to remove.

questions.q: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant ______ for a camera shoot.
questions.full: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant pose for a camera shoot.

questions.q: In order to draw her family tree, Mary tried to trace her ______ back to their arrival in North America.
questions.full: In order to draw her family tree, Mary tried to trace her ancestors back to their arrival in North America.

questions.q: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost ______ and the stock nearly gone.
questions.full: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost bare and the stock nearly gone.

questions.q: Even though Jack said "Sorry!" to me in person, I did not feel any ______ in his apology.
questions.full: Even though Jack said "Sorry!" to me in person, I did not feel any sincerity in his apology.

questions.q: My grandfather has astonishing powers of ______. He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.
questions.full: My grandfather has astonishing powers of recall. He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.

questions.q: Recent research has found lots of evidence to ______ the drug company's claims about its "miracle" tablets for curing cancer.
questions.full: Recent research has found lots of evidence to counter the drug company's claims about its "miracle" tablets for curing cancer.

questions.q: Corrupt officials and misguided policies have ______ the country's economy and burdened its people with enormous foreign debts.
questions.full: Corrupt officials and misguided policies have crippled the country's economy and burdened its people with enormous foreign debts.

questions.q: As a record number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were ______ with traffic all day.
questions.full: As a record number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were choked with traffic all day.

questions.q: Studies show that the ______ unbiased media are in fact often deeply influenced by political ideology.
questions.full: Studies show that the supposedly unbiased media are in fact often deeply influenced by political ideology.

questions.q: People who desire a ______ figure should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.
questions.full: People who desire a slender figure should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.

questions.q: Watching the sun ______ from a sea of clouds is a must-do activity for all visitors to Ali Mountain.
questions.full: Watching the sun emerging from a sea of clouds is a must-do activity for all visitors to Ali Mountain.

questions.q: Do you know what time the next bus is ______? I've been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.
questions.full: Do you know what time the next bus is due? I've been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.

questions.q: The roasting heat and high ______ made me feel hot and sticky, no matter what I did to cool off.
questions.full: The roasting heat and high humidity made me feel hot and sticky, no matter what I did to cool off.

questions.q: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt ______ the test of time.
questions.full: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt stand the test of time.

questions.q: In some countries, military service is ______ for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.
questions.full: In some countries, military service is compulsory for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.

questions.q: The team complained that its leader always took the ______ for all the hard work done by the team members.
questions.full: The team complained that its leader always took the credit for all the hard work done by the team members.

questions.q: Located at the center of the city, the business hotel ______ not only good service but also convenient public transport.
questions.full: Located at the center of the city, the business hotel promises not only good service but also convenient public transport.

questions.q: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an ______ for the public to donate blood.
questions.full: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an appeal for the public to donate blood.

questions.q: David felt disappointed when he found out that he could not choose his study partners, but would be ______ placed in a study group.
questions.full: David felt disappointed when he found out that he could not choose his study partners, but would be randomly placed in a study group.

questions.q: If you put a ______ under a leaking faucet, you will be surprised at the amount of water collected in 24 hours.
questions.full: If you put a container under a leaking faucet, you will be surprised at the amount of water collected in 24 hours.

questions.q: The local farmers' market is popular as it offers a variety of fresh seasonal ______ to people in the community.
questions.full: The local farmers' market is popular as it offers a variety of fresh seasonal produce to people in the community.

questions.q: As the years have passed by, many of my childhood memories are already ______; I can no longer recall clearly what happened back then.
questions.full: As the years have passed by, many of my childhood memories are already blurring; I can no longer recall clearly what happened back then.

questions.q: Racist remarks are by nature ______ and hurtful, and should be avoided on all occasions.
questions.full: Racist remarks are by nature offensive and hurtful, and should be avoided on all occasions.

questions.q: Not satisfied with the first ______ of her essay, Mary revised it several times before turning it in to the teacher.
questions.full: Not satisfied with the first draft of her essay, Mary revised it several times before turning it in to the teacher.

questions.q: Left ______ for years, the deserted house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.
questions.full: Left vacant for years, the deserted house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.

questions.q: The high school student showed ______ courage when she helped the old man escape from the fire.
questions.full: The high school student showed enormous courage when she helped the old man escape from the fire.

questions.q: Publicly financed projects are often ______ or delayed during tough economic times due to a lack of resources.
questions.full: Publicly financed projects are often halted or delayed during tough economic times due to a lack of resources.

questions.q: Despite his busy schedule, the President ______ the school's graduation ceremony with his presence and a heartwarming speech.
questions.full: Despite his busy schedule, the President graced the school's graduation ceremony with his presence and a heartwarming speech.

questions.q: The manager of the company was sued for ______ abusing his colleagues, calling them "hopeless losers."
questions.full: The manager of the company was sued for verbally abusing his colleagues, calling them "hopeless losers."

questions.q: The mayor has such a ______ schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
questions.full: The mayor has such a tight schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.

questions.q: Jane started as an ______ art designer, but now she has a professional studio of her own.
questions.full: Jane started as an amateur art designer, but now she has a professional studio of her own.

questions.q: The teaching ______ at the famous high school soon attracted more than a dozen well-qualified applicants.
questions.full: The teaching vacancy at the famous high school soon attracted more than a dozen well-qualified applicants.

questions.q: Designed by a young engineer, the new product has created far more profit than ______ expected.
questions.full: Designed by a young engineer, the new product has created far more profit than initially expected.

questions.q: It has been confirmed that a balanced ______ of fruit and vegetables is a key element to good health.
questions.full: It has been confirmed that a balanced consumption of fruit and vegetables is a key element to good health.

questions.q: As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy ______ the thought of speaking before large audiences.
questions.full: As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy dreads the thought of speaking before large audiences.

questions.q: To the newly-crowned winner of the piano competition, music is his life's ______, which he has devoted himself to whole-heartedly.
questions.full: To the newly-crowned winner of the piano competition, music is his life's passion, which he has devoted himself to whole-heartedly.

questions.q: The drunk driver who shouted at passers-by and ______ them with glass bottles was quickly arrested by the police.
questions.full: The drunk driver who shouted at passers-by and assaulted them with glass bottles was quickly arrested by the police.

questions.q: There were so many people at the bus station that I had to ______ my way through the crowd to board the bus in time.
questions.full: There were so many people at the bus station that I had to elbow my way through the crowd to board the bus in time.

questions.q: Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised ______ concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.
questions.full: Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised grave concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.
